name: Fast Food Manager 2
detailed_description:
Fast Food Manager 2 is not just a continuation of the legendary Fast Food Manager — it’s a much more refined and detailed business simulator focused on building a successful fast-food restaurant chain.
At its core, the game retains the same goal: start from scratch and grow a profitable business to become the market leader. But now, the experience is enriched with an engaging storyline, expanded features, and new gameplay mechanics that offer a deeper level of immersion.

Open new locations, purchase supplies, set up your workspaces, cook a variety of meals and drinks, manage your staff — and, of course, don’t forget about your competitors!

In this new version, managing your business has become even more convenient and exciting thanks to new gameplay possibilities:

  • You can now buy supplies manually or arrange direct deliveries to your points of sale.

  • Take the wheel and drive your own vehicle.

  • The range of available products has grown significantly, making your menu more diverse.

  • Finished goods can now be sold not only in restaurants, but also through direct delivery to customers.

  • Order fulfillment is easier than ever with the new multi-order system.

Build and grow your business using powerful new tools and expanded opportunities to achieve success!
